subject: Consolidation & SOW: Incident tooling (PagerLess) - next steps
messages:
From: Olivia Grant <olivia@pagerless.com>
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.com
Cc: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 1 Sep 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal: Enterprise SOW for Redwood Inference (consolidation)

Hi Tessa —

Thanks again for the time last week. As discussed, I’m attaching an updated SOW that consolidates our incident, on-call, and status page products into one enterprise SKU for Redwood Inference. High-level:
- 250 named users (on-call + observers)
- Enterprise incident routing (team-level escalation policies)
- SLA: 99.9% availability for the control plane, 15-minute on-call response target for P1
- One month overlap credit for migration from current vendors
- 12-month term with single annual payment or monthly subscription option

Attachment: PagerLess_Enterprise_SOW_v3.pdf (pdf, 420 KB)

I included two optional add-ons: priority support (24/7) and private status page hosting (for our EU customers). I flagged a potential data residency note for your legal team (we can support US & EU tenancy).

Next steps I propose:
1) Internal review of SOW/price and any compliance asks
2) If OK, DocuSign signature and PO issuance
3) One-week migration kickoff with our solutions team

Happy to hop on a short call to walk through the SOW line-by-line.

Best,
Olivia Grant
Head of Sales

Thanks Tessa — I pulled current spends and rough seat counts. Short summary:
- PagerDuty: $58,200/year (current on-call routing + escalation)
- OpsVendor: $21,400/year (small team licenses)
- StatusMirror: $6,800/year (public status pages + subscribers)

Total current run-rate: ~$86,400/year. PagerLess consolidated price in the SOW (annual, prepaid) would be $72,000 — net savings ~16.7% before considering migration costs. If we pick monthly billing, the rate is slightly higher (~$6,400/month) but gives flexibility.

Attached the vendor spend export for reference: current_vendor_spend.csv (csv)

Action items I see:
- Confirm whether we need private status hosting for EU customers (add ~+10% to line item)
- Decide annual prepaid (savings) vs monthly (flexibility)
- Legal review for termination & data residency

Jonas — want to highlight two clauses for legal to review: automatic renewal at year-end, and indemnity limits tied to revenue.

-stephanie
Head of Procurement, Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.com, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 5 Sep 2025 11:09:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Proposal: Enterprise SOW for Redwood Inference (consolidation)

Quick legal read: two items to push back on before signature:
1) Auto-renew: request explicit 60-day cancellation window and no silent fee increases.
2) Data residency / export: add binding clause that customer data for EU customers is stored in EU tenancy and that PagerLess provides audit logs on request for incidents.
3) SLA credits: define concrete credit calculation (e.g., % of monthly fee per P1 outage over 15 minutes).

I’ll put suggested language in tracked comments. If Olivia can accept these changes, procurement can prepare PO and we can seek approval from finance. If they won’t accept the changes, we should negotiate a 30-day pilot with opt-out.

-Jonas
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

From: Olivia Grant <olivia@pagerless.com>
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.com, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 10 Sep 2025 08:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: Enterprise SOW for Redwood Inference (concessions)

Hi team — thanks for the clear feedback. We can accommodate the majority of the asks:
- We’ll add a 60-day cancellation window and remove silent fee increase language.
- We can amend the SOW to specify EU tenancy for EU customer data and provide audit log exports on request (subject to standard NDAs).
- SLA credit calculation: we propose a sliding scale (5% credit for mid-level incidents, 15% for control-plane outages >30 minutes). We can tighten the P1 definition if you prefer.

Concessions summary attached: PagerLess_SOW_concessions_20250910.pdf (pdf)
DocuSign link: https://docusign.com/s/RED-PL-2025 (DocuSign_Link.txt)

Also, we can offer the one-month overlap credit (applied at invoice) and a migration assistance credit of $4,500 to cover initial setup.

If this looks OK we’ll prepare the final SOW for signature and send the DocuSign.

Best,
Olivia Grant
Head of Sales, PagerLess
